operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Hamas Misses Board of Peace Disarmament Deadline; Israeli Ministers Convene to Discuss War Resumption on Day 941
heroSubtitle: Hamas failed to accept the Board of Peace's 8-month phased disarmament framework by Saturday's end-of-week deadline, with a senior Israeli general declaring renewed war 'almost inevitable.' Israeli ministers convened to discuss renewing full-scale operations in Gaza. The Board of Peace previously signaled it will not hold Israel to October 2025 ceasefire terms if Hamas refuses — effectively removing international constraints on resumed military action. IDF struck a residential house in Shati refugee camp in Gaza City, wounding 6–9 Palestinians; Gaza's cumulative death toll reached 72,628+ killed and 864+ killed since the October 2025 ceasefire. Two Gaza flotilla activists — a Spanish and a Brazilian national — were released from Israeli detention after 11 days and are being deported. Hamas's counter-offer insisted weapons be discussed only within a framework ending in Palestinian statehood, a position Israel and the US rejected as non-starter.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, WAFA, IMEMC, AL-Monitor, and Jerusalem Post. Gaza death toll: 72,628+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (Gaza Ministry of Health / WAFA, May 9, 2026). 864+ killed since Oct 10, 2025 ceasefire framework as of May 9, 2026 (WAFA). Hamas missed Board of Peace disarmament deadline (May 9–10, 2026); Israeli ministers set to discuss war resumption. IDF senior general: resumed war 'almost inevitable.' Shati refugee camp struck May 9, 6–9 wounded. Flotilla activists Saif Abu Keshek (Spain) and Thiago Avila (Brazil) released from Israeli detention and to be deported. IDF Southern Command war-resumption operational plan presented to Israel's political leadership. 8,000+ bodies remain under Gaza rubble; only 1 functioning ICRC excavator. Board of Peace $17B+ reconstruction fund frozen pending Hamas disarmament. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, only ~10% funded.
